properties.name: Lac du Bois Grasslands Protected Area, inside the City of Kamloops
properties.ban: No firearms and no bows.
properties.rule: “The discharge of firearms and bows is prohibited on that portion of Lac du Bois Grasslands Protected Area or Crown lands that are within the City of Kamloops municipal boundary.”
properties.src: BC Hunting and Trapping Regulations Synopsis 2026 to 2028, page 33
properties.boundary: Official outlines: the protected area (TA_PARK_ECORES_PA_SVW) cut by the City of Kamloops boundary (ABMS_MUNICIPALITIES_SP)
properties.methods: No firearms and no bows, so no hunting with any of them.

properties.name: City of Kamloops
properties.ban: Crown land: no firearms and no bows. Private land: city bylaw.
properties.rule: Synopsis: no firearms or bows on Crown land inside the City of Kamloops boundary. Shooting on other land inside the city is set by city bylaw (not in the app). Map C7 also closes the South Thompson band.
properties.src: BC Hunting and Trapping Regulations Synopsis 2026 to 2028, page 33
properties.boundary: Official outline: City of Kamloops (ABMS_MUNICIPALITIES_SP). Which land is Crown land is not drawn here.
properties.methods: Part of this area bans shooting. The app cannot tell which part you are in.

properties.name: Tranquille Wildlife Management Area
properties.ban: No hunting and no shooting.
properties.rule: Map C17: the Tranquille Wildlife Management Area is a No Shooting or Hunting Area. The legal line (Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3 s. 2) also takes in Lot 341 and stops at the low water mark.
properties.src: BC Hunting and Trapping Regulations Synopsis 2026 to 2028, page 35
properties.boundary: Official outline: Tranquille WMA (TA_WILDLIFE_MGMT_AREAS_SVW). The legal area is close to it, not the same: check Map C17.
properties.methods: Closed to rifle, shotgun and bow.

properties.name: Marble Canyon Park

properties.boundary: Official outline: Marble Canyon Park (TA_PARK_ECORES_PA_SVW). The regulation draws the area on its own map: check Map C14.

properties.name: McQueen, Griffin and Isobel lakes, 1 km
properties.ban: No firearms (No Shooting Area).
properties.rule: “All land and waters within 1 km of the mean high water mark of McQueen, Griffin and Isobel Lakes.” (Map C12, Closed Areas Regulation Schedule 5 s. 4)
properties.src: BC Hunting and Trapping Regulations Synopsis 2026 to 2028, page 35
properties.boundary: Official lake outlines (FWA_LAKES_POLY) plus 1 km. The lake outline is close to, not the same as, the mean high water mark.
properties.methods: No firearms (rifle or shotgun). Bows and crossbows are allowed unless the region restricts them (page 10).

properties.name: Logan Lake (the water)
properties.ban: No firearms on the lake (No Shooting Area).
properties.rule: “Those waters of Logan Lake to the maximum high water mark.” (Map C6, Closed Areas Regulation Schedule 5 s. 9)
properties.src: BC Hunting and Trapping Regulations Synopsis 2026 to 2028, page 35
properties.boundary: Official lake outline (FWA_LAKES_POLY). The outline is close to, not the same as, the maximum high water mark.
properties.methods: No firearms (rifle or shotgun). Bows and crossbows are allowed unless the region restricts them (page 10).

properties.name: Tunkwa Lake, largest island
properties.ban: No hunting, shooting or trapping.
properties.rule: “The largest island in Tunkwa Lake, being in Township 19, Range 21, W6M.” (Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 1 s. 12. Not printed in the synopsis.)
properties.src: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 1 s. 12 (BC Wildlife Act)
properties.boundary: The largest island in the official Tunkwa Lake outline (FWA_LAKES_POLY). The regulation names the Kootenay Land District; the township and range match this lake (my reading).
properties.methods: Closed to rifle, shotgun and bow.
